scope: Wave 4: 18 new games × 5 levels each to reach 36 games total (12 engines × 3 packs)

production_rules.thumbnail_policy: Intentional square edit from approved cover, game-specific focal crop
production_rules.completion_policy: Compose approved hero art into game-specific completion treatment
production_rules.system_icon_policy: Retain Flutter system icons for back, close, volume, repeat, retry, accessibility
production_rules.background_policy: Keep boards quiet low-contrast behind interactive pieces; preschool simplest

shared_prompt_contract.brand: Majarra child-friendly premium children's game illustration
shared_prompt_contract.style: polished 2D storybook game art, rounded readable silhouettes, soft dimensional shading, clean edges, coherent line treatment
shared_prompt_contract.purpose: object immediately recognizable during gameplay and clear at small mobile size
shared_prompt_contract.framing: single clear focal subject, generous breathing room, no cropped important edges
shared_prompt_contract.camera: front or gentle three-quarter view, no dramatic perspective distortion
shared_prompt_contract.simplicity: low visual clutter, no tiny decorative details, strong separation subject and background
shared_prompt_contract.text_rule: no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols that resemble writing
shared_prompt_contract.rights_rule: no logos, no branded characters, no watermark, no signature
shared_prompt_contract.transparency_rule: standalone objects use plain removable background and preserve complete silhouette
